title: perturbation-prism-viability — result payload schema
description: Result payload for perturbation-prism-viability. PRISM data is compound-keyed, but evidence.json is gene-keyed: this payload aggregates compound viability response across compounds whose target-of-record matches the gene. One evidence.json per (gene, indication, subtype).

if.$comment: Finding B: median_log_viability_across_compounds aggregates over (compound × cell-line) pairs. When n_compounds_for_target=0 there are no pairs, so no numeric median exists — it must be null. When >0 a real number is required.

n_compounds_for_target.description: Number of distinct compounds in PRISM with this gene as target-of-record. Zero is allowed: a target with no chemical tools is informative.

compound_targets.description: List of compounds in PRISM annotated with this gene as target-of-record.

moa.description: Mechanism of action annotation if available.

median_log_viability_across_compounds.description: Median log2(viability) across (compound × cell-line) pairs in the indication-mapped lineage subset. Negative values indicate sensitivity. Null when n_compounds_for_target=0 (no compound×cell-line pairs to aggregate) — enforced by the top-level if/then/else.

lineage_selective_sensitivity_zscore.description: Z-score of this lineage's median log_viability vs the pan-cancer median. Negative = lineage is more sensitive than average.

by_mutation_context.description: OPTIONAL — compound-viability summaries within mutation contexts (e.g., KRAS-G12C lineage subset).

top_compounds_by_response.description: Top-N compounds (by absolute median log_viability) within the indication-mapped lineage subset.
